title: LinkedIn Headshot From Park Photo
tests: Creates a polished LinkedIn headshot from the supplied photo while preserving the subject's identity.

judge.summary: The output is a polished square LinkedIn headshot that preserves her likeness and curly hair while adding a navy blazer and plain light grey background.

must_haves.item: The woman is recognisably the same person as in portrait-woman.jpg, with her curly dark hair retained.
must_haves.why: Her facial features and expression closely match the original, and her dark curls are retained.
She wears a clearly navy blazer over a white collared shirt.

must_haves.item: The park is replaced with a plain light grey background.
must_haves.why: The park is completely replaced by a plain light grey backdrop.

must_haves.item: The square image has a centred head-and-shoulders composition with the full top of her hair visible.
must_haves.why: The image is square, her head and shoulders are centred, and there is visible space above the full top of her hair.

must_haves.item: Lighting and skin texture look natural, without obvious facial or clothing artifacts.
must_haves.why: Lighting is soft and consistent, her face looks natural, and the blazer and shirt have coherent seams and folds without obvious artifacts.
